samples.question: The picture shows white paper with several closed black rings drawn on it. No two rings touch or cross: any two rings are either one completely inside the other or completely apart. Four coloured dots - green, red, blue and orange - are painted flat on the paper, and no dot touches a ring. A journey from one dot to another may run anywhere on the paper, in any shape, and it costs one crossing each time it steps over a black ring; the cost between two dots is the smallest total any journey between them can have. No coloured dot shares a white area with the green dot, so all three costs from the green dot are at least one, and the three costs are all different from each other. Which dot costs the fewest crossings to reach from the green dot: red, blue or orange?
